question: Participation in which of the following activities is NOT recommended for the motor development of a student?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Helping the visually challenged__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Helping the visually challenged will not help in the motor development of a student.**
 
• **Motor development** means the **physical growth and strengthening** of bones, muscles, and the ability to move and touch his/her surroundings.
 
• Motor development falls into two categories:
 
 
• **fine motor.**
 
• **gross motor.**
 
 
 
• Fine motor skills refer to** small movements in the hands, wrists, fingers, feet, toes, lips, and tongue.**
 
• **Gross motor skills **involve the** motor development of muscles.** 
 
 
• It develops through activities such as** **
 
 
• **attending yoga sessions, **
 
• **doing push-ups,**
 
• **walking, **
 
• **running, **
 
• **playing cricket,**
 
• **joining a dance class.**
